based_on: A02/PR #7491; new allocation, not a rerun
delta: Replace A02 held offset with bounded PI integral state and conditional anti-windup; preregister no-worse 21-sample IAE as an added utility gate. All scenario initial conditions and plant parameters stay fixed.
hypothesis: A receiver whose PI integral state is initialized to match actually applied input, then updated online with conditional anti-windup, reduces first-output discontinuity >=25% without worsening finite-horizon cumulative tracking error or state bounds.
H: Conditioning dynamic PI state may preserve command continuity and tracking utility vs cold start in the selected scalar mapping.
T: Same scalar first-order plant and three frozen cases as A02, PI Kp=2, Ki=0.1/tick, state offset clamp [-1,1], output clamp [0,1], slew 0.2/tick, alpha 0.25/tick, 20 updates. Compare cold z=0 and conditioned z=u_applied-Kp*(ref-y); update z after each output by Ki*error unless error drives further saturation.
D: PASS only if both eligible cases reduce first jump >=25%, conditioned 21-sample IAE is no higher than cold, every route stays within [0,1], stale/missing/revoked/pre-quiescence controls deny actuation, delayed transfer quiesces before acceptance/actuation, mutations are observable, and independent oracle plus freeze hashes pass. A continuity pass with IAE tradeoff is reported as such, not overall PASS.
C: Cold PI may track faster; saturation may erase continuity contrast; anti-windup and chosen Ki may determine apparent benefit.
U: Synthetic scalar system only; no app/game, noisy/delayed observation, planner, model, physical actuator, or task outcome.

settings.settling_rule: three consecutive samples with absolute error <=0.05

controls: requested instead of actually applied input
execution: WSLc one CPU, 256 MiB configured, cached pinned RepoDigest, --pull never, network none, read-only source, distinct output; report kernel warnings; no memory-enforcement claim
